additional_info.subject: ID0405256-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R3 170001657] Missing Converters in DC2 CRM:00921001522
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin, good morning.
Yes bring a spare converter in case we need to replace it.
First thing you should do is swap this faulty converter with a neighbour one and check if it works.
If you swap them and the converter is still faulty, then replace it
If you swap them and the good converter is now faulty there must be something wrong with the cabling.
It can be CAN or AC.
Thank you
Best regards,
Francisco
